what_changed: OCC, Federal Reserve, FDIC and NCUA propose new risk-based third-party risk management guidance that would rescind and replace existing third-party risk management guidance.
compliant_agent_must_now: No change until final; if adopted, bank and credit union clients would tailor vendor oversight of an AI servicing provider to the assessed risk of the relationship, under guidance that replaces the 2023 interagency guidance.
open_questions_for_deploying_team: Which existing guidance would be rescinded (e.g., the 2023 interagency guidance in TPRM-001), and how would client due-diligence requests change?
rationale: Proposed interagency guidance replacing the existing third-party risk guidance; directly governs how banks and credit unions examine vendors. Stage A: title, abstract and metadata only; full text not read.
